CLIENT INSIGHTS / RETIREMENT

Start with the life
you want to live.

Retirement planning begins with a few useful questions. Use these as conversation prompts for a qualified adviser.

  • When would you like work to become optional?
  • What might your everyday expenses look like?
  • Which savings, pensions and other assets do you already have?
  • How could inflation, healthcare costs and a longer retirement affect your plan?
  • How much flexibility do you need along the way?

Keep reviewing your assumptions as life changes. The calculator illustrates compounding; it does not assess retirement readiness.
